{1: '1', 2: 'Young Helentine', 3: 'Why is Helena sad in the story?', 4: '1', 18: '100018942'}
{3: "Swan labors away at the soil, having just told little Helentine the story's ending."}
{1: '1', 2: 'Swan', 3: 'Because she missed her chance with the person she loved.', 4: '2', 18: '100018943'}
{2: 'Swan', 3: 'The person she failed to hold onto became her greatest regret.', 4: '2', 18: '100018944'}
{2: 'Young Helentine', 3: 'Love? Like how I love watching movies?', 4: '1', 18: '100018945'}
{2: 'Swan', 3: "My little Helentine, you're still too young to understand that just yet.", 4: '2', 18: '100018946'}
{3: 'Swan sets down her shovel, pauses to think, then turns to Helentine.'}
{2: 'Swan', 3: "Helentine, what I'm about to tell you... You don't have to understand it right now. When you...", 4: '2', 18: '100018947'}
{2: 'Swan', 3: "When you grow up and meet that person, you'll understand.", 4: '2', 18: '100018948'}
{2: 'Young Helentine', 3: "Okay, I'll remember that.", 4: '1', 18: '100018949'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory605.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiDianying.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Swan', 3: "Love is the sense of comfort that fills your heart when you see that person's silhouette.", 4: '2', 18: '100018950'}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: 'Keep the coat. You can give it back next time we meet.', 4: '1'}
{3: 'Raven drapes the coat over Helena, adjusting it carefully to shield her from the rain before turning to leave.'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1300.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Swan', 3: "Love is that intimate feeling when you're in each other's arms and never want to let go.", 18: '100018951'}
{2: '【kuroname】', 3: 'Helentine, the director said "cut."', 4: '15'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: 'Just a little longer.', 4: '1', 18: '100018952'}
{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUiFight/FxUiDianying.prefab'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1389.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Young Helentine', 3: "But I don't want to let go when you hug me either, Auntie Swan. Does that mean I love you too?", 4: '2', 18: '100018953'}
{3: 'Swan gently pats the young Helentine on the head.'}
{2: 'Swan', 3: 'Of course, Little Helentine. I love you very much too.', 4: '1', 18: '100018954'}
{2: 'Swan', 3: "But the kind of love I'm talking about is different. Sometimes... it can make you sad too.", 4: '1', 18: '100018955'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory637.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Swan', 3: 'Like when you see the person you love spending time with someone else, you can feel this... tightness inside your chest.', 18: '100018956'}
{3: 'Ellen is adjusting your posture, occasionally holding both your hands or wrapping an arm around your waist, and murmuring reassurances like "I\'ll catch you, just trust me and lean back."'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Helentine', 3: "Commandant and Ellen look like they're still busy.", 4: '1', 18: '100018957'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1389.jpg'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Swan', 3: "When you realize you might lose them, you'll feel this sense of panic.", 4: '2', 18: '100018958'}
{2: 'Swan', 3: 'Helena from the movie is the perfect example. She only realized she loved Raven when he was about to leave the city.', 4: '2', 18: '100018959'}
{2: 'Swan', 3: "That's why you feel that panic. By the time you try to stop that person from leaving, it's already too late.", 4: '2', 18: '100018960'}
{2: 'Young Helentine', 3: 'Auntie Swan... are you Helena from the film?', 4: '1', 18: '100018961'}
{3: "Helentine turns to look at her, only to find Swan's face already covered in tears."}
{3: 'Swan picks up the young Helentine, turns around, and speaks to her with utmost sincerity.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Swan', 3: "Helentine, if you ever meet someone you truly love, you have to fight for it. Don't let yourself live with regret.", 4: '2', 18: '100018962'}
{2: 'Swan', 3: "The film reel we're burying together can serve as a reminder.", 4: '2', 18: '100018963'}
{2: 'Young Helentine', 3: "Won't it be hard to dig up later if we bury it this deep under the parasol tree?", 4: '15', 18: '100018964'}
{2: 'Swan', 3: 'Some things only reveal their meaning when you work hard to uncover them yourself.', 4: '2', 18: '100018965'}
{2: 'Swan', 3: "When you meet someone you love, but don't know what to do about it, dig up this box together with that person.", 4: '2', 18: '100018966'}
{2: 'Young Helentine', 3: "I'll remember. So, if I'm not around the person I love... everything would feel wrong.", 4: '15', 18: '100018968'}
{2: 'Swan', 3: "That's one way to look at it for now. But when you truly realize those feelings, you must follow that impulse in your heart.", 4: '2', 18: '100018969'}
{1: '999', 2: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStoryFront/BgStoryFront12.png', 3: '0', 4: '1', 5: '0.4'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Young Helentine & Helentine', 3: 'Take the initiative...', 4: '15', 18: '100018967'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1388.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineSpreadNew.prefab', 2: '1'}

{1: 'PanelActor1Shake2Loop'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Helentine', 3: 'Auntie Swan, thanks for your reminder. I finally understand now.', 4: '1', 18: '100018970'}
{3: "Helentine runs at full speed, your hand firmly in her grasp—though you are still trying to figure out what's happening."}
{3: "But none of that matters right now. There's something she absolutely has to do."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory637.jpg'}

{2: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineSpreadNew.prefab'}
{3: 'Not long ago, inside the rehearsal room.'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Ellen', 3: "You're picking up the moves fast. The sequence is going to look great later.", 4: '1', 18: '100018971'}
{2: "I'm rather experienced when it comes to dancing.", 3: '121', 4: "What do you want me to say? That you're a good teacher?", 5: '120'}
{2: 'Ellen', 3: 'A great teacher makes great students, but the student has to have talent too.', 4: '1', 18: '100018972'}
{3: 'Ellen gives you an excited pat on the shoulder. Through the small window in the door, a blurry figure can be seen outside.'}
{2: 'Ellen', 3: 'If you guide Nelly a little when the time comes, we might just get that breakthrough we need...', 4: '1', 18: '100018973'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryWhiteNew.prefab', 2: '3'}
{1: '1', 3: 'The loud crash of the door draws the attention of both of you. Outside, Helentine stands past the door now groaning on its broken latches, breathing hard.'}
{2: 'Helentine?!'}
{3: "Without a word of explanation, she strides straight up to you, grabs your wrist, and whisks you away before either you or Ellen can process what's happening."}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Texture/Image/BgStory/BgStory1388.jpg'}
{1: 'Assets/Product/Effect/Prefab/FxUi/FxUiStoryNew/FxUiStoryLineSpreadNew.prefab', 2: '2'}
{1: 'RImgBg1Shake2Loop'}
{1: 'PanelActor1Shake2Loop'}
{1: '1', 3: 'Now, Helentine is pulling you along as she races through the streets in the studio set, while you struggle to match her pace.'}
{2: 'Helentine', 3: "Ellen, get ready for the starlit confession. We're filming that scene now.", 4: '1', 18: '100018975'}
{2: "That's sudden.", 3: '149'}
{1: '1', 2: 'Ellen', 3: "Alright! I'll get everything set up right away!", 4: '18', 18: '100018976'}
{2: 'Ellen', 3: 'Hang in there, Gray Raven Commandant!', 4: '18', 18: '100018977'}
{2: "What's happening?!", 3: '154'}
{2: 'Ellen', 3: "I have no idea! But the emotional intensity coming from Nelly right now is like nothing I've ever felt from her before!", 4: '18', 18: '100018978'}
{2: 'Ellen', 3: 'It looks like... there might actually be hope!', 4: '18', 18: '100018979'}

{3: "And so, you find yourself dragged along by Helentine's unyielding grip as you rush toward the final filming site."}
{3: 'All across Heleywood, the mechanoid crew springs into action, making their way to the location and beginning to set up lights and cameras.'}

{3: 'Everything is in place. The stage is set for the climax.'}
